subject: Preserving order with fortify and ggplot for multcomp objects

messages.author: 4ba72e55eaff0703
messages.subject: Preserving order with fortify and ggplot for multcomp objects
parts:
require("multcomp") amod <- aov(breaks ~ wool + tension, data = warpbreaks) CI <- confint(glht(amod, linfct = mcp(tension = "Tukey")))
fortify(CI) ggplot(CI, aes(lhs, estimate, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr)) + geom_pointrange()
How do I preserve the order of rows in wht as in
plot(CI)

M. Kubovy

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Preserving order with fortify and ggplot for multcomp objects
parts:
Hi:

Save the fortify(CI) output to an object, convert the lhs variable from character to an ordered factor and replot:

CIf <- fortify(CI)
str(CIf)     # a data frame
CIf$LHS <- factor(CIf$lhs, levels = c("H - M", "H - L", "M - L"))
ggplot(CIf, aes(LHS, estimate, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr)) +
   geom_pointrange() + coord_flip()

Dennis
